experiences.name: Tatte Bakery & Café
experiences.description: Bright bakery café in the old Charles Street Meeting House, known for pastries and shakshuka.

experiences.name: Beacon Hill Books & Cafe
experiences.description: Independent bookstore in a five-story townhouse, with a small café inside.

experiences.name: Boston Public Garden
experiences.description: Historic public park with a lagoon, a footbridge and the Make Way for Ducklings statues.

experiences.name: Charles River Esplanade & Hatch Shell
experiences.description: Riverside park path along the Charles, centered on the Hatch Memorial Shell. Good for walks and sunsets.
experiences.address: 47 David G Mugar Way, Boston, MA 02108

experiences.name: Boston Public Library, Central Library
experiences.description: Landmark library in Copley Square with murals, a courtyard and the grand Bates Hall reading room. Free to visit.

experiences.name: Trident Booksellers & Café
experiences.description: Bookstore and all-day café on Newbury Street, popular for brunch and browsing.

experiences.name: Pavement Coffeehouse
experiences.description: Local coffee shop chain's Newbury Street café, with bagels and a cozy room for studying.

experiences.name: Mike's Pastry
experiences.description: Famous North End pastry shop known for cannoli in its signature white box.

experiences.name: Caffè Vittoria
experiences.description: Old-school Italian café on Hanover Street for espresso, gelato and cannoli. Stays open late.

experiences.name: Bova's Bakery
experiences.description: Family-run Italian bakery open 24 hours, a classic stop for late-night cannoli and calzones.

experiences.name: Pizzeria Regina
experiences.description: The original North End location of a pizzeria open since 1926, serving brick-oven pies.

experiences.name: Paul Revere House
experiences.description: Paul Revere's 17th-century home, one of the oldest buildings in downtown Boston and a Freedom Trail stop.

experiences.name: Harvard Book Store
experiences.description: Independent bookstore in Harvard Square with new and used books and a busy author events series.

experiences.name: Harvard Art Museums
experiences.description: Three museums under one glass roof, from Asian art to modern European painting. Admission is free for everyone.

experiences.name: Harvard Yard
experiences.description: The historic heart of Harvard's campus, with the John Harvard statue and leafy paths open to the public.
experiences.address: Massachusetts Ave & Peabody St, Cambridge, MA 02138

experiences.name: Pinocchio's Pizza & Subs
experiences.description: Harvard Square pizza shop since 1966, known as "Noch's" and famous for late-night Sicilian slices.

experiences.name: MIT Museum
experiences.description: Museum of science, technology and art in Kendall Square, with robots, holograms and rotating exhibits.

experiences.name: Graffiti Alley (Modica Way)
experiences.description: A walkway off Mass Ave where graffiti is legal and the murals change constantly. Free.

experiences.name: Flour Bakery + Café
experiences.description: Popular Boston bakery's Central Square location, known for sticky buns and sandwiches.

experiences.name: Museum of Fine Arts, Boston
experiences.description: One of the largest art museums in the country, with collections from ancient Egypt to contemporary art. Many local colleges get students in free.
experiences.nearest_station: Museum of Fine Arts (Green Line E)

experiences.name: Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum
experiences.description: A Venetian-style palace filled with art around a flowering courtyard. Student tickets are discounted, and Thursday nights are free.
experiences.nearest_station: Museum of Fine Arts (Green Line E)

experiences.name: James P. Kelleher Rose Garden
experiences.description: Free formal rose garden tucked inside the Back Bay Fens, at its best in early summer.
experiences.nearest_station: Museum of Fine Arts (Green Line E)

experiences.name: Institute of Contemporary Art (ICA)
experiences.description: Contemporary art museum cantilevered over Boston Harbor, with harbor views from the glass-walled gallery.

experiences.name: Fan Pier Park & Harborwalk
experiences.description: Waterfront lawn and harbor walk with skyline views, next to the ICA. Free.

experiences.name: Boston Tea Party Ships & Museum
experiences.description: Floating museum with replica ships and costumed guides where you can throw tea into the harbor.

experiences.name: Flour Bakery + Café (Fort Point)
experiences.description: Fort Point location of the Boston bakery, an easy stop for coffee and a pastry near the Seaport.

experiences.name: Chinatown Gate
experiences.description: Ornate paifang gate marking the entrance to Boston's Chinatown, with a small park beside it. Free.
experiences.address: Beach St & Surface Rd, Boston, MA 02111

experiences.name: Double Chin
experiences.description: Modern Asian comfort food and dessert spot, known for its cube toast. Open late, especially on weekends.

experiences.name: Hei La Moon
experiences.description: Large Cantonese restaurant known for daytime dim sum, good for groups.

experiences.name: Dumpling Cafe
experiences.description: Casual Taiwanese spot for soup dumplings and noodles at student-friendly prices, open late.
